question: In which US state was the firing squad reintroduced and used in 2025?
answer: The firing squad had not been used for 15 years. In 2025, South Carolina used it again, one of the older execution methods the US has brought back in recent years.
move: The firing squad came back in South Carolina in 2025, after 15 unused years.
